games.name: [+1] Loot Evo
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') return rs:FindFirstChild('ClickRequest', true) ~= nil and rs:FindFirstChild('RebirthRequest', true) ~= nil

games.name: Sell Ores
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') return rs:FindFirstChild('BaseBuildPurchaseTunnel', true) ~= nil

games.name: Drill Blocks for Brainrots
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') return rs:FindFirstChild('IncrementStrength', true) ~= nil and rs:FindFirstChild('ItemsConfigurations', true) ~= nil

games.name: Make a Drill Farm
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') return rs:FindFirstChild('SpinDrillService', true) ~= nil

games.name: Clean all the leaves!
games.note: lobby and map are separate places; every map place is caught by detect
games.detect: local plr = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer local ps = plr and plr:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts') if ps and ps:FindFirstChild('LeafSim') then return true end local rem = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Remotes') if rem and rem:FindFirstChild('EmptyBackpack') then return true end return rem ~= nil and rem:FindFirstChild('UpgradeBuy') ~= nil and game.Workspace:FindFirstChild('Teams') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Skill Point Legends
games.detect: local src = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('Source') return src ~= nil and src:FindFirstChild('Packets') ~= nil and src:FindFirstChild('Utils') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Speed Monkey Escape
games.note: second place id is the dev's TestPlaceID out of Config.Game
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local cfg = rs:FindFirstChild('Config') return cfg ~= nil and cfg:FindFirstChild('Treadmills') ~= nil and cfg:FindFirstChild('Upgrades') ~= nil and rs:FindFirstChild('Remotes') ~= nil and rs.Remotes:FindFirstChild('PromptTreadmill') ~= nil

games.name: Dig & Clean
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local ts = rs:FindFirstChild('TS') local c = ts and ts:FindFirstChild('constants') return c ~= nil and c:FindFirstChild('DiggingConfig', true) ~= nil and c:FindFirstChild('SprayBottles', true) ~= nil

games.name: +1 Muscle Evolution
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local sh = rs:FindFirstChild('Shared') local cfg = sh and sh:FindFirstChild('Configs') return cfg ~= nil and cfg:FindFirstChild('StrengthLevels') ~= nil and cfg:FindFirstChild('WinButtons') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Power Per Click
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') return rs:FindFirstChild('ClickTrainEvent') ~= nil and rs:FindFirstChild('WallConfig') ~= nil and rs:FindFirstChild('CaveHitEvent') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Drain Water Per Click
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local r = rs:FindFirstChild('Remote') if not r then return false end local e = r:FindFirstChild('Event') return e ~= nil and e:FindFirstChild('Level') ~= nil and e.Level:FindFirstChild('[C-S]Click') ~= nil and r:FindFirstChild('Function') ~= nil and r.Function:FindFirstChild('FishShow') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Wings for Brainrots
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local rem = rs:FindFirstChild('Remotes') local ev = rs:FindFirstChild('Events') return rem ~= nil and ev ~= nil and rem:FindFirstChild('PlaceBestRequested') ~= nil and ev:FindFirstChild('RequestSlotUpgrade') ~= nil and game.Workspace:FindFirstChild('ItemSpawners') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Speed Evolve
games.note: each world is its own place id; all four run the same script
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local m = rs:FindFirstChild('Modules') local sh = m and m:FindFirstChild('Shared') if not sh then return false end local svc = sh:FindFirstChild('RemoteEventService') return svc ~= nil and svc:FindFirstChild('AddSpeedRemoteEvent') ~= nil and sh:FindFirstChild('EvolutionData') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Jetpack for Brainrots
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local src = rs:FindFirstChild('Source') if not src then return false end local info = src:FindFirstChild('Info') return info ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild('BrainrotsInfo') ~= nil and info:FindFirstChild('JetpacksInfo') ~= nil and game.Workspace:FindFirstChild('Brainrots') ~= nil

games.name: +1 Mine Per Click
games.note: game runs the ZAC anticheat - executor fingerprint scan only, no movement checks
games.detect: local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local rem = rs:FindFirstChild('Remotes') local srv = rem and rem:FindFirstChild('Server') local db = rs:FindFirstChild('Databases') return srv ~= nil and srv:FindFirstChild('HitWall') ~= nil and db ~= nil and db:FindFirstChild('PickaxeList') ~= nil

games.name: Grow a Chicken Fighter
games.note: collector + hatcher only, no shared panel yet
games.detect: return game.Workspace:FindFirstChild('NestEggs') ~= nil and game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('HatchEgg', true) ~= nil
